composition: open upper field, dense lower frieze
description: Top-down line drawing of a propeller warplane with RAF roundels occupies the upper portion of a white ground, bisected by two vertical yellow bands. Below, collaged elements include a gold scallop-patterned rectangle bearing a turquoise star, three silver compact discs, a football, a concentric-circle target, and rows of printed dots along the right margin.
title: Drafting Table

composition: axial totem on dotted ground, dense base pile
description: Mixed-media collage layering compact discs, yellow tape strips, holographic foil fragments, and printed technical diagrams onto a perforated white ground. Centrally positioned, a hand-drawn aircraft outline incorporates iridescent CDs as landing gear and engine components, surrounded by target rings, red ink splashes, and photographic fragments at the lower register.
title: Float

composition: diagonal cascade of discs over central plane
description: Three silver compact discs cascade down a gold-foil ground over a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane. Strips of red lettering and small game-target stickers line the upper edge; the surface is densely worked, with overlapping foils and crease marks.
title: Untitled (Three Discs Descending)
Children with Warplane
description: Loose ink-drawn figures of children and adults fill a large white ground, with orange spray paint emanating from behind the central group. A side-view warplane model is held horizontally across the central child's torso, accompanied by small collaged elements at lower left and bottom center.
composition: multiple figures arranged across horizontal plane
near-symmetrical scatter on white ground
description: Mixed-media collage on white ground combines compact discs, top-down and side-view warplane silhouettes, and photographic flower panels referencing Warhol's Flowers series. Red triangular forms, iridescent holographic zigzag elements, and hand-drawn ink marks distribute across the picture plane in near-symmetrical arrangement.
title: Flowers, Planes, Discs
Untitled (Turquoise Field Drawing)
description: Turquoise ground supports dense, layered mark-making in black ink with scattered patches of orange, yellow, green, magenta, and white paint. Gestural stick figures, tree-like forms, a side-profile warplane, and loose schematic drawings are distributed across the wide horizontal composition.
composition: wide horizontal field with scattered mark-making

title: Untitled (Face with Discs)
description: Two iridescent compact discs are positioned symmetrically across the midsection of a white ground, beneath loosely drawn facial features rendered in ink. Gestural line work surrounds the face and discs, with a faint warplane silhouette visible near the upper portion and a partial mechanical element at bottom center.
composition: Symmetrical discs below central drawn face
keywords: loose line drawing face mixed media

composition: bilateral maze structure with CD punctuation
description: Large-scale wall-mounted sculpture composed of layered white paper or card panels arranged in an irregular, maze-like formation, interspersed with navy horizontal stripe elements. Compact discs are affixed at regular intervals across the surface, creating a rhythmic punctuation throughout the asymmetric, bilaterally balanced composition.
title: Untitled (CD Grid Formation)
Untitled (Numan Collage)
description: Mixed-media collage dominated by a bold horizontal red band bearing white cut-leaf forms, above a dense lower zone of silver foil, compact discs, orange triangles, black geometric shapes, and scattered red fragments. Handwritten inscription 'NUMAN' appears at upper right; signed and dated 11/30/2022 at lower right.
composition: horizontal red band over fragmented lower zone

title: Face with Five Discs
description: White translucent paper forms a mask-like face centered on a densely layered collage ground of red, yellow, and silver fragments. Five iridescent compact discs serve as eyes and forehead elements, while a black floppy-disc-like square anchors the mouth area.
composition: central mask face on collaged border

title: Guernica London Spain
description: Mixed-media collage featuring multiple warplane silhouettes in side and top-down views, surrounded by concentric target rings, compact discs, and handwritten text including 'GUERNICA', 'LONDON', and 'SPAIN'. Orange tape strips, black ink lines, and a central framed white panel anchor the layered composition.
composition: central framed panel with peripheral warplane clusters

title: Merry Christmas 2013
description: Vertical collage on white ground features two top-down warplane silhouettes, scattered compact discs, and yellow vertical stripes. Handwritten text reading 'Merry Christmas 2013' anchors the lower edge alongside a row of concentric-ring motifs.
composition: scattered elements across tall vertical ground

title: Untitled (Collage with Targets)
description: Dense mixed-media collage incorporating multiple target rings, compact discs, American footballs, printed text fragments, and a small inset photograph of a red automobile. Handwritten names appear in the lower left corner alongside layered paper ephemera, yellow cardboard framing, and ink markings across a white ground.
composition: dense layered fragments across white ground
keywords: mixed-media collage with football and targets

title: Buy Me (Chess)
description: Dense mixed-media collage dated 3/7/12 incorporates chess pieces, archery targets, a football, and handwritten text reading "BUY ME" across a layered ground of torn paper, yellow tape, and painted marks. Red cross motifs, concentric-ring bullseyes, and black ink outlines accumulate across a white-dominant surface framed in black.
composition: dense layered accumulation across horizontal plane
keywords: yellow tape cross marks layered collage

title: Untitled (Planes and Targets)
description: Mixed-media collage on white paper featuring two top-down warplane silhouettes aligned vertically along a central axis of stacked compact discs and ribbon stripes. Soccer ball, bullseye targets, concentric spiral motifs, and scattered perforated dots populate the surrounding white ground.
composition: vertical axis with scattered peripheral elements
keywords: soccer ball and compact disc mixed media

title: Installation View, Andrea Allison
description: Wide horizontal installation panorama of a gallery wall hung with two large patterned collage panels in red, white, and target rings. The gallery name 'ANDREA ALLISON' appears on the right wall; warm interior light across the long view.

title: Embracing Lovers
description: Spray-painted on a white exterior wall, continuous orange and black linework depicts two intertwined figures with red-accented facial features, hands, and red shorts, accompanied by smaller marginal characters including a snowman and a helmeted figure at lower left. Signed 'Ricky Bird' in the lower-right corner; a metal bollard and bicycle wheel partially occupy the foreground.
composition: central figure mural with snowman witnesses

title: Red Meerkat, Snowman
description: Red interlocking typographic forms construct a standing meerkat figure centered on a dark concrete-block wall, with a yellow-black horizon band behind it. Secondary elements include a small cartoon character with glasses at right, a snowman motif, graffiti tag, and 'OSCH' and 'UNI' signatures at lower left.
composition: central tall figure on landscape wall

title: Lehrjahre Face
description: Layered paste-ups and spray-painted tags cover a pale wall, centered on a black-and-white portrait poster with dripping paint and the text 'MR FAHRENHEIT'; surrounding elements include stenciled snowman figures, green spray gestures, skull motifs, the word 'CINE,' and partially torn papers bearing the letters 'EAT.'
composition: central paste-up face on layered tag wall

title: Car Park, Snowman Cat
description: Urban facade photograph featuring a large wheat-pasted cat-face stencil with white eyes centered on a weathered building wall, flanked by a blue 'CAR PARK' directional sign and a small stick-figure motif upper left. Foreground includes a red vehicle and orange construction barriers.
composition: central paste-up over urban entrance

title: Yellow Mountains, Snowman
description: Yellow-and-black mural painted within a Gothic brick arch, depicting stacked owl-like faces composed of concentric circles, spirals, triangular forms, zigzag fills, and scale patterns. At the apex, a small stick-figure character with raised arms is rendered in white outline against the yellow ground.
composition: central archway mural, patterned mountain field

title: Rifle Stencil, Snowman
description: Layered street art on a dark wall features a black-and-white stenciled figure holding an automatic rifle below spray-painted text reading 'BEN NAZ,' accompanied by a small cartoon character with glasses and a circular skull-and-laurel emblem at left. At right, a yellow and white illustrated building paste-up adjoins orange-painted graffiti tags.
composition: central rifle stencil with text and snowman icon

title: Hot Pink Tag, Snowman Trio
description: Layered spray-paint tags in magenta, teal, white, and black cover a dark-paneled metal surface, accumulating across multiple sessions of application. Partially legible letterforms overlap figurative elements including a blue rounded form with a white halo and a stacked three-circle motif at center-right.
composition: all-over graffiti field with central snowman trio

title: Dance Club Records
description: Red brick wall bearing layered graffiti: a large blue spray-painted skull with lettering at top, a white oval panel stenciled 'DANCE CLUB RECORDS' at center, and a white outline snowman stack at left. Lower right features a black-and-white eye motif; scattered tags, a heart outline, and white circular patterns fill remaining surface areas.
composition: central skull with text panel on red brick

title: TEAR Figure
description: Street mural on a weathered blue wall depicting a stylized figure rendered in dense black-and-white horizontal stripes, with a fragmented hatched face showing pink lips and heavy-lidded eyes. Cascading black rectangular tags bearing the word 'TEAR' descend along the left side; small looping chain motifs appear at the shoulders.
composition: central tall paste-up on blue wall

title: Two Faces, Snowman Field
description: Pale wall surface layered with spray-painted marks including two loosely rendered faces in black and blue, one bearing a single red dot, and a stenciled skull within a radial burst at center-lower. Small circular snowman figures line the lower edges, and a black-outlined cartoon figure stands in the upper right corner.
composition: stencil cluster on wall, snowman scatter base

title: How Will This Benefit Me
description: Brown-painted door surface covered with layered stickers, paste-ups, graffiti tags, and spray-painted lettering in white, blue, orange, and black. Lower center features a blue-faced figure in a skull-adorned cap and epaulettes accompanied by the text "How will this benefit me?"; a snowman motif, brass mail slot, and dense overlapping printed ephemera occupy the upper register.
composition: central paste-up with text on tagged door

title: Sticker Door
description: Red-framed door divided into two registers: upper panel densely covered with overlapping stickers, tags, and printed labels including '#CODEFC,' 'ABOVE,' 'OLE,' and 'REKA.' Lower panel displays black brushwork figures — a large abstracted head with red circular glasses, a suited tuxedo form, and layered graffiti tags in black, red, and blue.
composition: two-panel red door with stickers above, stencil below

title: No More Poor Doors
description: Blue-painted billboard surface layered with multiple stickers and paste-ups, including a red panel depicting three white snowmen above a black silhouette figure holding a vertical placard reading 'NO MORE POOR DOORS / CLASS WAR.' Additional stickers read 'CLYDE P' and 'RECORDS'; weathered and partially torn remnants occupy the lower register above a brick wall.
composition: central paste-up on blue utility box

title: Wall and Pavement, Snowmen
description: Two-register street photograph: above, a cubist red, white and blue paste-up reading 'CARRIER' and 'EAR' with stylised faces in linocut style; below, a cream pavement covered in black graffiti tags hosts three small white Mr. Snowmann figures in spread formation.
composition: two-register: paste-up wall above, tagged pavement below
